ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light-grey) to 35% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense low-intensity pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edge and median notch. High-intensity pixels dominate the central lobes, interspersed with low-intensity linear streaks and small focal spots. Contiguous dark regions are most prominent at the distal tips and the axial junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 40-45 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 2-5% of lobe height along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged texture is localized near the fluke tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the medial-to-lateral trailing edge, terminating in sharply tapered, slightly upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-contrast white textured pixel groups localized on the extreme outer tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral surfaces of both lobes, particularly visible in the central and basal regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rake marks across both lobes and heavy barnacle encrustation on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, small circular dark ring-shaped pigmentation mark located in the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe (observer's right).
